rops.name: ROPS
rops.desc: Two-post roll bar. Keep it upright and wear the seat belt when mowing. Check the mounting bolts are tight at each service.

seat.name: Seat and seat switch
seat.desc: Seat switch is part of the safety interlocks: test the interlocks daily. Original seat 104-4620 is obsolete (bulletin GR 02-10); replacement for this machine is seat 139-2680, no install kit needed.

steering.name: Steering wheel
steering.desc: Hydraulic power steering to the rear wheel. Grease the steering fork shaft and the steering cylinder ends every 50 h and after every wash.

console.name: Control console
console.desc: Throttle, choke, mow/backlap and lift controls, hour meter and the hydraulic leak-detector alarm. Test the leak-detector alarm daily: ignition on, hold the switch rearward, alarm after 1 s.

fronttube.name: Front frame tube
fronttube.desc: Main front frame and steering-column support. Check welds and mounts for cracks at each service; the machine is at about 3,600 h.

hyd.name: Hydraulic valve, hoses and leak detector
hyd.desc: Hydrostatic traction, reel drive and lift. Fluid 25.7 L Toro Premium All Season (108-1178 pail). Hydraulic filter 107-9531: first at 50 h, then 800 h with the fluid and tank breather 115-9793. Check hoses daily; replace moving hoses every 2 years (hose kit 117-2725). Fit the oil cooler kit for hot weather or verticutting.

frame.name: Frame and footrest
frame.desc: After washing: a few drops of SAE 30 or WD-40 on the mow, lift and brake pivots, then grease all fittings.

engine.name: Engine bay: Briggs & Stratton Vanguard V-twin (570 cc)
engine.desc: Model 356447, Toro part 130-6472. Oil 1.4 L SAE 30 (API SJ+). Oil and filter 107-7817 first at 25 h then every 100 h. Air cleaner: foam pre-cleaner 92-0530 every 50 h, paper cartridge 92-0527 every 100 h. Plugs (2) Champion RC14YC 0.76 mm, 23 N.m, and in-line fuel filter 94-2690 every 800 h. Clean the cooling fins daily. Low idle 1650 rpm, high idle 2850 rpm.

tyreFR.name: Front tyre (left)
tyreFR.desc: 18 x 9.50-8, 2-ply. Front 55-83 kPa (8-12 psi). Wheel nuts 95-122 N.m in an X pattern (1 h, 10 h, then every 200 h). Burnish the brakes yearly. RHS wheel-bearing squeak is open on the workshop list: rear wheel bearing cone and seal 115-9472 (x2).

cu1.name: Cutting unit, left front
cu1.desc: 21 in DPA reel (04652 8-blade / 04654 11-blade / 04656 14-blade). At 4-5 mm on tees the Tournament bedknife 93-4263 fits best (13 new screws 119-4151 per knife). Backlap when dull; grind when backlap will not restore the edge (30 deg relief, land 0.8-1.2 mm). Reel service limit 114.3 mm. Grease 3 bearing housings + 2 rollers per unit every 50 h.

cu2.name: Cutting unit, right front
cu2.desc: Same unit as the left front. Check reel-to-bedknife contact daily (light contact, cuts paper across the width) and height of cut (4-5 mm).

cu3.name: Cutting unit, rear centre
cu3.desc: Sits under the frame between the front wheels. Same unit and parts as the front two; grease the reel-motor spline and lift arm whenever it is removed.

battery.name: 12 V battery
battery.desc: Flooded lead-acid (Toro 104-8162). Check the electrolyte every 50 h, top up with distilled water. Check the hold-down at 50 h.

fueltank.name: Fuel tank
fueltank.desc: Unleaded petrol, 87 octane (R+M)/2 (= standard 91 RON in AU), up to E10. No E15+ or methanol. In-line fuel filter 94-2690: interval in the engine entry.

hoses.name: Cutting unit and lift hoses
hoses.desc: Hydraulic hoses to the reel motors and lift. Check hoses daily for leaks, kinks, wear and loose fittings; replace moving hoses every 2 years.

reelmotor.name: Reel motor (hydraulic)
reelmotor.desc: Hydraulic reel motor on the end of the cutting unit: the reels are driven hydraulically. Check the hoses and fittings at the motor with the daily hose check.

115-9472.name: Rear wheel bearing cone and seal

model.note: Part outlines are traced from Toro's product photo of the Greensmaster 3150-Q and are approximate; the rear cutting unit and battery are hidden in this view and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from parts catalog 3422-507, operator's manual 3422-495 and cutting-unit catalog 3414-467. Engine parts beyond filters and plugs come through Briggs & Stratton.

93-4263: Bedknife Tournament 3.1-12.7 mm (best fit for 4-5 mm tees)
132-7340: Reel assy 21 in low drag 8 / 11 / 14 blade
104-8162: Toro dealer or battery supplier (match size/CCA)
